label: Sliding-door residential burglaries, Tarzana, Woodland Hills and Downey, Los Angeles area, 2026
area: Tarzana, Woodland Hills and Downey, Los Angeles, CA

sources.publisher: Video linked from the LAPD release as released by detectives; hosted on YouTube
City News Service in the Downey Patriot

linking_evidence: LAPD Robbery-Homicide Division identified two suspects from the February 2026 Tarzana and Woodland Hills burglaries, where entry was by smashing rear sliding glass doors
the subsequent investigation linked four of the five suspects to Downey burglaries; the first link is not explained
ground_truth.notes: Each of the two records stands for a group of burglaries whose count is not reported. Police believe there are additional unreported burglaries. Items seized from the suspects include hand-held radios, masks, gloves, Wi-Fi jammers, two vehicles, weapons and ammunition; which items tie to which incident is not reported. Three evidence photos are in the series photos folder. The five booking portraits on the release page were not downloaded. The video link comes from the release update of 2026-10-21. The release page gives no captions for the evidence images; the descriptions in the photos sources file are our own.

outcome.summary: Five suspects arrested. Two booked for burglary with bail of 165,000 and 150,000 dollars; three booked for attempted burglary with bail of 50,000 to 90,000 dollars. Later outcome not reported.

data_policy: Public sources only. No suspect or victim names, ages, or exact addresses.
